title: SMProfile-ProductionOrder payload (NATS, MQTT)
description: GENERATED from standard/profiles/operations/production-order.json 4.0.0 by i3x-v5 packages/schemas-ci/gen-payloads.mjs; do not edit by hand. Shape: entity (envelope.schema.json).

production_order_no.description: Join key — identity of the OperationsRequest. The OperationsResponse reports its actuals back via the same key (RESPONDS_TO).

article_ref.description: Article to be manufactured (article_no, join key to Article).

machine_ref.description: Planned executing machine / line (machine_no), reached via SegmentRequirement REQUIRES_EQUIPMENT Machine (machine_id).

department_ref.description: ERP department the order is routed to. Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/production-order.md, attributes › department_ref › description.

qty_planned.description: Planned piece count (target). Counterpart to OperationsResponse.quantity_produced. Driver of the qty_shortfall rule.

planned_start_time.description: Planned START of the order's next non-terminal operation. Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/production-order.md, attributes › planned_start_time › description.

planned_end_time.description: Planned completion date (target). Counterpart to actual_end_time. Driver of the late_delivery rule.

dispatch_sequence.description: 1-based position of this order in its machine's dispatch queue, inside the 24 h horizon. Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/production-order.md, attributes › dispatch_sequence › description.

parts_per_shot.description: Number of good parts ONE machine cycle yields — the mould's cavity count on injection-moulding machines, 1 on single-part machines. Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/production-order.md, attributes › parts_per_shot › description.

mould_ref.description: Identity of the mounted mould/tool that determines parts_per_shot (e.g. Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/production-order.md, attributes › mould_ref › description.

material_ready_at.description: Time from which material is available — material-ready constraint.

customer_order_qty.description: Customer order quantity of the triggering order (denormalized).

customer_due_date.description: Customer delivery date of the triggering order (denormalized).

order_no.description: COMPATIBILITY KEY, adopted from the withdrawn SMProfile-CustomerOrder on 2026-08-13. Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/production-order.md, attributes › order_no › description.

customer_ref.description: Customer of the triggering demand (kunde_id). Adopted from SMProfile-CustomerOrder 2026-08-13; the same column the withdrawn source read. The customer reference lives in this key (no ISA-95 edge, owner 25.09.).

customer_name.description: Customer name (kunde_name). Adopted from SMProfile-CustomerOrder 2026-08-13. THIS SOURCE IS NOW THE ONLY WRITER: measured in the live KG, customer_name is set on 48.486 nodes and every one of them was written by the withdrawn erp-customer-orders binding. 100 % populated on the live feed.

total_amount.description: Order value (gesamtbetrag). Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/production-order.md, attributes › total_amount › description.

currency.description: Currency of total_amount (waehrung). Adopted from SMProfile-CustomerOrder 2026-08-13. Fill rate measured on the live feed: 461/500 rows.

due_date.description: Customer delivery commitment (lieferdatum_soll). Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/production-order.md, attributes › due_date › description.

quantity.description: Ordered piece count (geplante_stueckzahl). Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/production-order.md, attributes › quantity › description.

status.description: Plan status of the OperationsRequest, as it reaches THIS profile through OUR source binding. Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/production-order.md, attributes › status › description.

updated_at.description: Last change. Server-managed and volatile on every read (sim-v5 returns a fresh value per GET), so promotion:never — kept in the snapshot but excluded from the change-trigger and never published on its own.
